parity_cases.question: Summarise the primary results of the Verazolimab trial in stage II diabetic nephropathy.
parity_cases.answer: The trial enrolled 3013 participants. Recruitment ran across 19 sites. The treatment period lasted 43 weeks. The primary endpoint improved by 11.7 percent relative to placebo.
